name: Grand Vestibule
summary: At the Grand Vestibule, Scarlet sentries guard the passage into the monastery’s inner halls. Crimson pillars and statues of fallen crusaders line the entrance.

sections.title: The Threshold of Zealotry
sections.body: Past the Scarlet Monastery’s outer gates, you enter a marble hall lined with pillars and statues of armored champions. Scarlet sentries, disciples, and augurs patrol the flagstones. They strike down anyone who enters without the order’s crimson tabard. Here, the Crusade’s strict discipline meets its fervor.

sections.title: A Contested Meeting Ground
sections.body: Every intruder must cross the Grand Vestibule to reach the monastery’s guarded inner wings. Alliance champions sent north and Horde forces advancing from the nearby Undercity both face the Crusade’s defenders beneath its high arches. Beyond them lie the inner cloisters.

faq.answer: The Grand Vestibule is an entrance chamber in northeastern Tirisfal Glades. It links the Scarlet Monastery’s outer courtyard to its four inner wings.
Scarlet Sentries, Scarlet Disciples, and Scarlet Augurs guard the chamber for the Scarlet Crusade and bar intruders.

faq.q: Why do the Alliance and Horde fight here?
faq.answer: Alliance champions enter the monastery to strike at the Crusade’s zealots, while the Horde seeks to secure Tirisfal Glades for the Forsaken. Both cross the same entrance hall, though no recorded battle between the factions took place there.

faq.q: Whom do the statues in the vestibule depict?
faq.answer: The statues depict honored Scarlet Crusade warriors and heroes in heavy plate armor. They are symbols of the Crusade’s fight against the undead.

angles.text: As an undead, you face the living zealots threatening Forsaken sovereignty in Tirisfal from this grand entryway northeast of the Undercity.
As an Alliance champion, you see how Lordaeron’s former holy sanctuaries have been corrupted. Devotion to the Light has turned to violent fanaticism.
